annotations.text:
KetoClub — the app, built out in direction A.

The row deliberately mixes both themes: Discovery and Restaurant menu open light, the other three open dark. Every screen carries its own Light/Dark tweak above the artboard, so any of them flips — and Settings' own Appearance control drives its screen live.

The traffic lights are no longer a dot: each dish gets a coloured left rail, a labelled status pill, a tinted card and a matching net-carb chip. The three counters under the venue name are the filter — tap one.
Photo tiles are placeholders — real imagery comes from the Wolt/10bis feeds at runtime. Restaurant and dish data is invented; the waiter scripts follow the README's templates.
